name: handoff
description: Write a session handoff file, keep it current at milestones, and print where it is.

dir.title: Handoff folder
dir.description: Where handoff files go when you don't name a place. Absolute, ~/..., or relative to the project root. Empty: <project root>/docs/handoffs/.

level.title: Default level
level.description: Default level for /handoff. low: a light backup (what automatic updates write). medium: the full handoff, and fix stale statements in project notes and memory. high: medium plus a subagent check. Automatic updates are always low.

auto.title: Automatic updates
auto.description: on: keep the handoff up to date, silently, at milestones in interactive sessions. off: only when you run /handoff; the session is not told about automatic updates at all.
